'use strict';
const U=require('./util.cjs'),C=require('../runtime/common.cjs'),K=require('../runtime/policy.cjs'),F=require('../runtime/check-profile.cjs');
const SOURCE_PARENT='91b9a99226a7a135a0e75b8a1d0db255eefe2200';
const SOURCE_MESSAGE='perf(compat): compact diagnostic envelope and bounded preview work';
const PATHS=Object.freeze(['docs/treasury-compat-diagnostic-envelope-optimization-xii.md','docs/treasury-compat-loader-optimization.json','docs/treasury-compat-source-manifest.json','scripts/build-treasury-compat-loader.cjs','scripts/lib/treasury-compat-envelope.cjs','src/runtime/treasuryCompatCpu.ts','src/runtime/treasuryCompatRead.ts','test/treasury-compat/envelope-optimization.spec.cjs','test/treasury-compat/fixtures/cpu-before-diagnostic-envelope-xii.ts.txt','test/treasury-compat/fixtures/reader-before-diagnostic-envelope-xii.ts.txt','test/treasuryCompatRead.test.ts']);
function verifyPinned(repo){const tree=U.textGit(repo,['rev-parse',K.COMPAT+'^{tree}']);if(tree!==K.SOURCE_TREE)C.fail('ENVELOPE_XII_RETRY_SOURCE_TREE_CHANGED');if(U.textGit(repo,['rev-parse',K.COMPAT+'^'])!==SOURCE_PARENT)C.fail('ENVELOPE_XII_RETRY_SOURCE_PARENT_CHANGED');if(U.textGit(repo,['show','-s','--format=%s',K.COMPAT])!==SOURCE_MESSAGE)C.fail('ENVELOPE_XII_RETRY_SOURCE_MESSAGE_CHANGED');const names=U.textGit(repo,['diff','--name-only',SOURCE_PARENT,K.COMPAT]).split('\n').filter(Boolean).sort();if(JSON.stringify(names)!==JSON.stringify([...PATHS].sort()))C.fail('ENVELOPE_XII_RETRY_SOURCE_SCOPE_CHANGED');return{status:'ENVELOPE_XII_RETRY_SOURCE_OBJECT_VERIFIED',head:K.COMPAT,tree,base:SOURCE_PARENT,changedPaths:PATHS.length};}
function verifyHead(repo){U.exactHead(repo,K.COMPAT,'compat/treasury-read-bridge-i');const v=verifyPinned(repo);F.verifyFrozen(repo);return{...v,status:'ENVELOPE_XII_RETRY_SOURCE_VERIFIED'};}
module.exports={SOURCE_PARENT,SOURCE_MESSAGE,PATHS,verifyPinned,verifyHead,verifyBaseline:verifyHead};
